about.text: Rennet curd cut, drained of its whey, salted, shaped and, for most, ripened. How finely it is cut, how hot it is scalded, whether it is pressed, stretched, brined or washed, and how long bacteria and moulds work on it make the families of cheese, from fresh cheese eaten within days to hard cheese kept for years.

sources.text: About 26 Mt of natural cheese in 2023 (23.8 Mt of it from cows’ milk, 90% of all), less the fresh cheese set with acid: the curd, pressed and salted, a little lighter than it went in.
